_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05 (batch S3). Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Bumbleride Indie All-Terrain Stroller

clekListed.clekRow: Bumbleride Indie — Indie/Speed Car Seat Adapter – Maxi-Cosi/Cybex/Nuna (MNC-28)

specs._foldedNote: 31.5 x 24.5 x 13 in with rear wheels on; 31.5 x 17.5 x 13 in with quick-release rear wheels removed.

brake.type: foot-operated one-step parking brake linking both rear wheels (sandal-friendly)
brake.power: One-step foot brake links both rear wheels; certified to AS/NZS 2088 (stricter parking-brake + tether standard). No published brake-force figure or wrist tether.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth-ready (built-in infant mode / lay-flat); also works with bassinet or infant car seat

safety.standards: ASTM F833 (US 16 CFR 1227); EN 1888 (EU); AS/NZS 2088 (AU/NZ); SOR/85-379 (Canada)
safety.certifications: OEKO-TEX Standard 100 non-toxic recycled fabrics; 5-point harness. Not JPMA-listed.
safety.notes: Cargo basket 17 x 15 x 11 in, 15 lb. Handle range 26–46 in adjustable.

recall.summary: Feb 2012 CPSC/Health Canada recall of ~28,000 US (2,700 CA) Indie strollers, model numbers I-107/I-110/I-205 made Jan 2009–Aug 2011: the front wheel could break at the axle hub, causing tip-over/fall hazard (36 wheel-crack incidents, 2 tip-overs with minor injuries). Remedy was a free front-wheel retrofit kit. Applies only to those 2009–2011 model numbers, not current Indie units.

specs.tires: all three 12 in air-filled; all-wheel suspension; front swivel with in-line lock
specs._tiresNote: The Indie is an all-terrain (not sport-jogging) stroller; front swivel wheel with lock rather than a fixed jogging wheel.

notes: All-terrain single, 24 lb — the lightest Bumbleride here and compact folded without rear wheels (17.5 in wide). Clek Liing latches via the Indie/Speed adapter MNC-28 (adapter-mnc-28), which explicitly lists the Clek Liing. Good all-around city + light-trail stroller; heavier than a true travel stroller but versatile.
